defect.before: A checked-out pg client emitted an unhandled error after TCP loss following real COMMIT; Vitest captured the event, while normal Node would terminate. Query failures alone did not consume the client error event.
defect.fix: Listen for checked-out client errors; avoid rollback on known lost connection, preserve the original failure, discard failed clients and remove the listener after release. No automatic SQL/HTTP replay and no false rollback guarantee.
defect.status: Fixed and verified in uncommitted working tree; not yet integrated into staging or approved by teammate

executionSemantics.acknowledgementLoss: Test-only TCP proxy forwards real PostgreSQL traffic, then suppresses completion packets and closes sockets only after CommandComplete and ReadyForQuery I prove backend commit; independent direct DB reads verify durable consequences. No mocked SQL result or forced Promise rejection.
executionSemantics.deadlock: Actual cyclic lock wait between route transaction (Survey row plus response writes) and independent control transaction (advisory lock); pg_blocking_pids proves first dependency, application-side advisory lock closes cycle; native driver 40P01 asserted. Additional lock is test-only, not a production lock-order change.
executionSemantics.serialization: Actual PostgreSQL trigger emits SQLSTATE 40001 after Answer insertion; rollback/retry verified. This is not naturally generated SSI write skew. Production writes use READ COMMITTED; reads use REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY.
executionSemantics.authenticationAmbiguity: The row can be fully committed when acknowledgement is lost. Test verifies safe 503, no usable new cookie, old guest replay denied and no automatic resave. It does not falsely require an already committed row to disappear.
executionSemantics.logging: Positive actual registered pool error handler invoked with synthetic marker; fixed diagnostic observed; normal/invalid-answer routes and all console methods inspected for known credentials/tokens/cookies/secret/feedback marker. This remains selected boundary coverage, not comprehensive logging certification.
